prompt: Dehydration: 2-methylcyclohexan-1-ol + H2SO4, heat. Draw the MAJOR alkene (Zaitsev).

traps.note: Hofmann (less substituted) is minor here. H+/heat strongly prefers Zaitsev.

explanation: E1 goes through a 2° carbocation; loss of H+ from the more substituted β-C gives the more stable trisubstituted alkene (1-methylcyclohexene). The other direction gives a disubstituted alkene (3-methylcyclohexene), minor.
